topic: What feed element spacing balance minimizes dB loss while maintaining beamforming flexibility in defocused systems?
consensus_response: Optimal feed element spacing balances array factor, interference, and robustness. Element pattern shaping and polarization optimization reduce mutual coupling, allowing tighter spacing. Adaptive beamforming algorithms dynamically optimize beam patterns, minimizing dB loss and enhancing flexibility.
reference_context: Defocused reflector antennas are robust against feed failures, with reduced gain loss and improved SNR.
